atoms.text:
Tomorrow is Rachel’s eleventh birthday party. She is thinking about the amount of biscuits she needs to bake.

At the last few parties she attended, she observed how many biscuits the guests ate.

There were 3 guests at Max’s party, and they ate 9 biscuits. At Julie’s party there were 5 guests, and they ate 15 biscuits. Karla’s 7 guests ate 21 biscuits. At George’s party there were 2 guests and 6 biscuits were eaten.
